mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.member_id, p.title, p.content, p.created_at, m.name AS writer_name FROM post p JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id ORDER BY p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT p.post_id, p.member_id, p.title, p.content, p.created_at, m.name AS writer_name FROM post p JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (member_id, title, content) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{title}, #{content})
